body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.billing.delta HIGH - sudden token skew seen by aggregator-prod. Affects ~12% of customers. Pager: @maya-oncall @sam-sre
maya-oncall: joining. what's the current customer impact?
sam-sre: seeing ~1.2M tokens backlogged, aggregator counters +18% vs upstream. overage flags firing to billing-alerts. investigating emitter->aggregator path.
javier-billing: I've muted outgoing overage emails for 10m to avoid noisy customer notices — will confirm before extending. :no_entry_sign:
leah-support: 2 customers already in #support reporting spikes. holding replies until we know scope and credits.
maya-oncall: can we stop further double-counting quickly?
sam-sre: deploying a short-term ingest dedupe filter keyed on emitter+window. pushing to prod now.
ops-bot: deploy started: metering/dedupe-filter hotfix -> prod (job job-87432). est 45s.
sam-sre: rolling, monitoring metrics. this stops new duplicates; backlog still needs reconciliation.
javier-billing: preparing a manual correction flow to subtract deduped tokens from ledgers once we confirm scope. marking affected accounts "billing-review".
maya-oncall: share the query estimating duplicate counts.
sam-sre: query:
```
SELECT emitter_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, approx_distinct(event_id) as deduped
FROM metering.events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY emitter_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
sam-sre: early: top 20 emitters ~92% of delta. suspect emitter client v1.3.1 retry bug.
javier-billing: good signal. I'll pause automated collection and prep credit templates.
leah-support: tag affected account IDs in tickets for consistent replies.
maya-oncall: can we route traffic off suspect emitter cluster?
sam-sre: shifting eu-2 away to fallback-proxy for 10m. initiating now.
ops-bot: traffic-shift initiated: eu-2 -> fallback-proxy (gradual). job job-87490.
maya-oncall: token_rate drops ~80% after shift. mitigation effective.
leah-support: customers asking ETA for credits — javier?
javier-billing: if duplicates only and backlog reconciles automatically, credits within 2-4h. else manual backfill 4-12h.
sam-sre: backlog consumer ETA ~90m to steady state.
maya-oncall: plan: suppress overage emails (javier), dedupe filter (sam), route traffic (sam), identify scope (sam), credits (javier), comms (leah). owners assigned.
javier-billing: will simulate adjustments in staging ledger before applying.
sam-sre: will produce CSV: emitter_id, account_id, duplicated_tokens. sample: emitter: eu-2-3, account: acct_12F, dup_tokens: 124532
maya-oncall: once CSV validated, javier can run billing-admin batch.
leah-support: drafting holding message for customers, will wait for CSV.
ops-bot: deploy job job-87432 completed successfully.
sam-sre: dedupe filter stopped new duplicates; estimated duplicate tokens across window: ~2.3M.
javier-billing: staging sim maps to ~$1200 across flagged accounts.
maya-oncall: annotate dashboard with emit_rate, ingest_lag, deduped_count.
sam-sre: adding dashboard annotation and pinning to incident.
leah-support: updating tickets with affected account list and estimated credit window 2-6h.
javier-billing: preparing billing-admin batch: batch-apply-credits-540765. will post sign-off before execution.
ops-bot: traffic-shift job job-87490 succeeded.
sam-sre: root cause identified: emitter client v1.3.1 retry on ack loss causing replay. PR 4567 fixes it. coordinating release.
javier-billing: after credits, will disable automated overage flags for affected window to avoid report churn.
leah-support: sending initial holding message to customers now (empathetic, short). linking ticket once CSV ready.
maya-oncall: wrap-up: duplicates stopped, backlog draining, credits queued, postmortem + deploy follow-up. closing pager when done.
leah-support: creating incident ticket in ops board with actions assigned.
maya-oncall: closing pager. will update incident record and runbook. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident resolved state set by maya-oncall. Closing pager thread.
